Title: Trigger
Content: Objective You can set the triggers and sync URL at Trigger menu. Location Steps Set Sync Set Render Trigger Set Webhook Details 1) Location Group Console Developer page Trigger Choose a company to set trigger 2) Steps [Set sync] 1. Enter the URL and click 'Update' button. 2. Go to style page. You can see the sync button activated. 3. Click sync button to open new tab with the URL you entered above. The new tab's URL contains Style ID, style version, external style ID as query string. [Set Render trigger] 1. Click 'ADD TRIGGER' under Render section. 2. Choose workflow status that fires the trigger. 3. Go to Workroom or Style page and change Workflow of style. 4. Render is then requested. To see in on the page, you need to refresh. *Render will be requested with the uploaded file's render properties set in CLO S/W. [Set Webhook] 1. Click 'Add trigger' under webhook section. 2. Choose Workflow status that you want to fire the trigger. 3. Enter the URL that webhook will be requested. 4. Enter the Name and Value if you want to check whether the request is valid. It will be added in HTTP header with webhook request. 5. Go to Workroom or Style page and change workflow of style. 6. Webhook firing will be requested soon. Webhook request body sample { "UpdateTime": "2020-07-21T06:25:09.759785Z", "UpdateUser": "hello@clo-set.com", "Topic": { "TopicId": "4ea0710a0e5f4e099d92f7a284d167f9", "Version": 1, "TopicType": 1 }, "TriggerType": 1, "TriggerOption": { "WorkflowSeq": 1679, "TriggerStatus": 1 } } Webhook body schema { "UpdateTime": { "$id": "#/properties/UpdateTime", "type": "string", "format": "date-time", "description": "The update time that trigger fired." }, "UpdateUser": { "$id": "#/properties/UpdateUser", "type": "string", "description": "Email address of user" }, "Topic": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic", "type": "object", "description": "The updated space/style information", "required": [ "TopicId", "Version", "TopicType" ], "properties": { "TopicId": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/TopicId", "type": "string", "description": "The id of updated style or space" }, "Version": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/Version", "type": "integer", "description": "Version of style. Will be '0' if topic type is not style.", "default": 0 }, "TopicType": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/TopicType", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "Enum for what the topic type is. 0 is none, 1 is style.", "default": "None" } } }, "TriggerType": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerType", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "The trigger type that webhook triggered. 0 is none, 1 is workflow", "default": 0 }, "TriggerOption": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption", "type": "object", "description": "The object information for trigger", "required": [ "WorkflowSeq", "TriggerStatus" ], "properties": { "WorkflowSeq": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption/properties/WorkflowSeq", "type": "integer", "description": "Workflow seq that tiggered." }, "TriggerStatus": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption/properties/TriggerStatus", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "The changed trigger status for triggered object. 0 is none, 1 is changed", "default": 0 } } } }

Title: Assortment
Content: Objective 'Assortment' is a Space level for assortment planning &amp final review. You can also create Virtual Showroom as well as Mix &amp Match within Assortment. Create Assortment / Add Contents Viewing Modes Excel Download Virtual Showroom Mix &amp Match Assortment Comment Details 1) Create Assortment / Add Contents Create Assortment Create Assortment in Season page 1. Click icon from the 'Season' Space. 2. Enter Assortment name and click 'CONFIRM' button. Add Style to Assortment in Workroom page 1. Put the mouse cursor on the desired Style and click theicon. 2. Click 'Add to Assortment'. User must be Admin or Collaborator to add Content to Assortment. Add Style to Assortment in Assortment page 1. Click icon and select the desired style to add into Assortment. 2. Select the desired style from EXPLORER or add the style you recently worked on from RECENT. 2) Viewing Modes Viewer Mode Drop Down Menu Quickly switch the viewer option between 2D, 3D, and Render. Hover over the style in Assortment Room, and you will see a drop-down menu on the upper right corner. Click to switch viewer modes! By Viewer Mode 2D 3D Render *When viewing in Render mode, selecting a colorway OUTSIDE the viewer will NOT be reflected. *Colorway list is from the original Zprj file. New colorway added from CLO-SET Configurator will not show. To add new colorways, upload a new Zprj file, and move the garment to Assortment room. Synchronized Camera in Assortment Synchronized Camera in Assortment, by allowing users to add multiple Contents in Assortment and view them at the same time with the customized multiview. Select the desired 3D contents and activate 3D Viewers by clicking the 'Viewer' button in the 3D window. When the 3D viewer has been activated, turn on the Synchronized Camera mode by clicking the 'Synchronized' button on the top of the 3D contents. Now, you can review and control multiple 3D contents with the customized multiview at the same time. Note: In accordance with the release of Synchronized Camera, My bag Function will discontinue its service and be replaced from October 5, 2021. 3) Excel Download You may utilize Excel Download ( ) to export the info of Contents within the Assortment. 4) Virtual Showroom You may create a Virtual Showroom using the 3D Contents within your Assortment. Please follow the link to find detailed guidelines on how to set up your Virtual Showroom. 6) Simple Mix &amp Match Mix &amp Match your Contents to review the full style. You can try mixing up the combination to see which designs go well together. 7) Assortment Comment Commenting is available at the Assortment level. Please follow the hyperlink for more details including Permissions.

Title: Billing & Payment Email Notification
Content: Objective Understand the types of email notification you receive from CLO-SET regarding payment and plan. Who receives the updates? Payment/Invoice Complete Failed / Cancelled New user (additional charges) Plan change Upgrade Downgrade / Settled Addition Credit Details 1) Who receives the updates? Group Admin and Group Operators will be notified of the updates on payment/plan/charges of the Group. Group Admin is the owner account of the Group and cannot be changed. However, you may add/edit Group Operators on Console - Settings - Group Settings. Learn more about CLO-SET Permission Please note that payment/plan related notifications cannot be turned off. 2) Payment/Invoice Complete When the Group initiates or renews the plan and the payment has been complete successfully, you will receive below notification. Invoice/Charges List the invoice and details including the invoice number, issued date, and item details Carryover Balance (if applicable) If your Group has addition/deduction credits from the previous measurement, it will be applied to your payment. Learn more from billing guideline. Payment Total Total amount paid by the Group on the noted date. Failed / Cancelled You will receive a notification if a payment attempt fails. CLO-SET offers a 5-day grace period with 3 automatic payment retries. Your subscription will remain active during this time. If payment is completed within the grace period, your subscription and billing cycle continue as usual otherwise, your subscription will be cancelled. Once the grace period is over, your card payment will be cancelled along with your subscription. 3) New User (Additional Charges) When there is an update on your Group member list, it will be reflected on your Billing History. You will be notified of such updates via email. 3) Plan Change When there is an update on your subscription or plan, you will receive an email notification. Upgrade When you upgrade your plan from Standard to Premium, changes will be made instantly. The unused amounts will be refunded in the form of credit to be used on your upgrade payment. You will receive a notification detailing the new plan and paid amount as displayed here. Downgrade / Settled Addition Credit When you downgrade your plan, you will receive email notification. Please note that the downgrade will take place after your current measurement period is over. If your group has addition credit due to adding more users within the previous measurement cycle, you will be charged for the addition credit at the end of your subscription. Once this amount is paid, your Group will be downgraded to the Free plan.

Title: Payment Method & Process
Content: Objective Understand how to complete payments on CLO-SET and troubleshooting process. Payment Process Change Card &amp Billing Address Troubleshooting Payments Details 1) Payment Process 1. Go to https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing. Find plan details, and click 'Subscribe' to start. 2. Start by entering your Payment information. Click on 'Enter Payment Details'. Insert card number, expiration date, security code, along with the cardholder name and address. Then, click 'Confirm'. 3. Once the payment info is registered, confirm billed amount, agree to the Terms, and click 'Order' to complete the payment Subscription amount is based on the Plan Type, and the # of users in your Group. If you have any carryover balance, it will be reflected on the bill as shown below (#2). 4. Once the payment is complete, you will see the below page. Start enjoying your subscription. 2) Change Card &amp Billing Address To change the credit card information or billing address, visit Console - Summary page. Click 'Change' next to your payment information. Click 'Change Card' to update card information or billing address. *Console page is accessible for Group Admin and Group Operator only. 3) Troubleshooting Payments Payment attempts may fail for several reasons. See below for a list of errors and how to resolve them. [Your Group exceeds the number of Companies or Workrooms available under the plan] This error is displayed when the Group attempts to downgrade the plan. If your Group's usage exceeds the limits of the selected plan, downgrading cannot be completed. Please review the limitations for each plan and make the necessary adjustments. Then, try downgrading again. [There are Addition Credits that your Group should settle before re-subscribing] This error is due to having unpaid credit balance on your account. As such cases need further review, please contact our support. [Failed to register card information due to card issue] Please double check your credit card information or billing address. If the issue persists, contact us. [Upon upgrading, any remaining free trial period will be forfeited, and the payment will be charged immediately] This message is not an error, but a notification. If you are currently on a Trial period, initiating a paid subscription would forfeit the remaining Trial period.

Title: Billing Guideline
Content: Objective Understand how CLO-SET Group Pricing works, as well as invoices and billing. Payment per Group Automatic Renewal Who is included in the bill? Adding/Removing Users What is Credit? Refund Example: Your Billing History Explained Details 1. Payment per Group CLO-SET Pricing plan operates on a Group level. Subscribing to the Standard or Premium plan will be applied to all members within your Group. 2. Automatic Renewal Your subscription will be renewed every month. The monthly payment amount for your subscription may vary based on the number of users within your Group. *All renewals are made on the same day your subscription started. As an exception, if you subscribed on the 31st, renewal will be done on the last day of every month (ex. on the months with 30 days only, your renewal will be on the 30th). 3. Who is included in the bill? All users who were invited to or shared into the Group are included in the billing. This includes any user with permission to the Group, including Group Admin, Company Admin, Company Collaborator, Brand Admin, Brand Collaborator, Editor, and Viewer. Users with Group Operator permission only are not counted. Find out more on Permissions HERE. To view or manage your Group's permissions, please visit Permission Management tab. 4. Adding/Removing users during your subscription You may need to add additional team members to your Group after your subscription has begun. Adding User: Charged on the next billing cycle. Amount calculated on a daily basis. Each additional user will be charged for the # of days they were in the Group (ex. for Premium Plan: $40 # of days in month). The amount will be recorded as Credit on your Group. Please see below for an example. Removing User: If you delete a user during your billing cycle, the amount of unused days will be refunded in a form of Credit on your account (ex. for Premium Plan: $40 # of days in month). This additional Credit will automatically be used on your next payment. However, these addition credit cannot be transferred into cash refunds. Please see below for an example. * Added users are billed from the day they have been added. Removed users are refunded including the day they have been removed. * All 'days' are counted based on the UTC timezone. 5. What is Credit? Any changes on number of users within your Group will be reflected on your Group's Credit. All Credit Balance will be processed in your next payment. See below for examples. 6. Refund CLO-SET does not provide refunds for the subscription once it is initiated. Addition credits will be forfeited without cash refunds when downgrading to the Free plan. Your credit balance will be retained when switching between Premium and Standard plans. 7. Example: Your Billing History Explained Subscription Created: Billed for 5 users on the Premium Plan. Payment Complete: Payment complete, subscription started for 5 users. Added 1 User to the Group: The additional user will be billed as a prorated credit based on the number of days remaining until the renewal date. The accrued credit will be charged on the Group's next renewal date. In this example, total credit billed is $33.10 (Price per user / Total days in billing period) * Remaining days until renewal ($40 / 29) * 24 = $33.10 This amount is billed on your next renewal date. Removed 1 User from the Group: The unused days for this member will be refunded as a credit and automatically applied to your next payment. In this example, total credit refunded is $33.33 (Price per user / Total days in billing period) * Remaining days until renewal ($40 / 30) * 25 = $33.33 This amount will automatically apply to your next payment. However, canceling your subscription (switching to the Free Plan) will forfeit this credit.

Title: 2-month Free Trial
Content: Objective Understand how to activate your 2-month Trial offer. Activate Trial Cancel Trial FAQ Details 1. Activate Trial If your Group has applied for a 2-month Trial in advance (prior to November 3rd), the Group Admin and Group Operator will see the below pop-up modal and receive emails. To activate Trial, you must select a new plan and enter your payment information starting November 5th. Your monthly payment begins after the 2-month Trial period. You may cancel the Trial anytime. This offer is valid until December 31st. If you do not activate your Trial until then, the offer will be forfeited. To activate the Trial, you must select a new plan and confirm your payment information. Visit the new Pricing Page to follow the steps. Select a plan and enter your card details to start the trial at no charge. Billing will begin after the 2-month trial period. Please note the date displayed on the modal above. 2. Cancel Trial You may cancel your Trial at anytime. Visit Console &gt Summary and click 'Change Plan' &gt select 'Free Plan'. Make sure to cancel your Trial before the expiration date to avoid unwanted payments. Please note that failure to cancel the Trial before the expiration will result in renewing the subscription with a payment. CLO-SET does not provide refunds on unused days of the subscription, unless required by law. 3. FAQ 1. I applied for the Trial before November 3rd, but I do not see the pop-up modal or email. What happened? Trial activation can only be done by the Group Admin or Group Operator. If you do not see the button, please contact your Group Admin. 2. I haven't applied for the Trial in advance. What should I do? If you have not applied for the Trial offer in advanced, please select one of the new plans and start your subscription. 3. I was subscribed to the Advanced Plan before. What is changing for me? If you have been using CLO-SET Advanced Plan and have applied for the Trial, you can enjoy the new Trial period for the next 2 months after your current subscription period ends. Please follow the steps on the Activate Trial menu. 4. What happens after I cancel my Trial? After your Trial period is over, your Group will be downgraded to the Free Plan and would have limited CLO-SET availability. Please review the new restrictions of the Free Plan on the CLO-SET Pricing Page.

Title: Console - Statistics
Content: Permission: Group Admin, Group Operator Objective Access Admin Console by clicking icon on your CLO-SET dashboard. Admin Console shows the Group summary, Billing, Statistics, Activity Log, Settings, and Developer Page. On the Statistics tab, you may review details on your user activity and Content statistics. User Activity Content Statistics Total Color Composition Rate Trends Chart Scatter Chart Details Menu Sub-Menu Details Statistics User Activity Content Statistics View usage statistics per user, including content views and rendering usage. In addition, view Color analytics of your Contents. 1) User Activity Filter the time period to view Filter the type of users to view Active users are anyone with more at least 1 count of the measured values. Inactive users are those who did not use any of the counted values. Search specific users with their registered name or email to view their usage Name and Email of the user. Users who have been deleted from the Group and no longer have permission will be greyed out. Click on the field to sort - either in ascending or descending order 2) Content Statistics Filter the Date &amp Workroom you want to view For Group Operators, the 'Space' filter will only display the list of Spaces to which they have Viewer or above permission to. Group Admin can select any Space within the Group. Total Style Contents: Total number of Contents uploaded during the date range, and included in the statistics shown below. This covers ONLY the Contents you have viewing permission to. Average Used Colors: Average number of Colors used per Style Content Total Fabric Colors: Total number of Fabric Color used within the selected Space *ONLY Applicable to any Content uploaded on March, 2023 and onward. 1. Total Color Composition Rate The Doughnut Chart on the left shows the distribution of Primary Colors used for the Style Contents. Hover over the Color to view the details. On the right hand table, click on each Primary Color to view all the related Original Colors. Primary Color: Main Color(Hex/Pantone) with the highest usage rate among similar color group Original Color: All unique Colors used. Grouped by Primary Color. *Color usage rate is calculated based on the fabric size 2. Trends Chart Trends Chart shows the number of Style Content that used the top 10 Primary Colors over time. You may view the Color Trend chronically. Change the chart type to Bar or Line, or change period to Week or Year to change the view. Bar Chart Line Chart 3. Scatter Chart Scatter Chart visualizes the Saturation/Brightness of the Colors used. Click on the Primary Color to view the Original Colors included in the group. X-axis: Hue (Color Spectrum of 0~360) Y-axis: Saturation or Brightness per your selection. Click on the upper left dropdown button to switch the view. Marker Size: Number of Style Contents that used the selected Color.

Title: Change Plan / Unsubscribe
Content: Objective Learn how to cancel your Advanced Plan subscription and downgrade to free plan. Change Plan Upgrade Downgrade (Unsubscribe) Refund Policy *Before you start: Plan type can only be managed by Group Admin or Group Operator. Changing your plan type will affect everyone in your Group. Details 1) Change Plan To change your plan type, visit Console - Summary. Make sure you are in the correct Group. Check the Group name on the top-left corner of your screen. To switch Groups, click on the downward arrow () next to the Group name. Click 'Change Plan' on the right to select a new plan. Upgrade Upgrading will take place immediately after the payment is made. 1. Upgrading from Standard to Premium Your remaining measurement period for the Standard plan will be refunded in credit form, to be applied automatically for your new Premium plan subscription. Example) Billing changes when upgrading from Standard to Premium 1. Once the upgrading is initiated, your Standard plan subscription will be cancelled. If you had any remaining days under the Standard plan, the unused days will be refunded in the form of credit. In this example, $92.80 has been refunded (for the unused 28 days, for 5 users). This resulted in a total credit balance of $54.24 based on previous bill history (which means that the previous credit balance was -$38.56) 2. Premium plan subscription created immediately. A new bill is created for 5 users with a charge of $200 ($40 x 5). This resulted in a total credit balance of -$145.76 ($54.24 - $200.00). Negative credit indicates that the user owes the amount to be paid. 3. Payment completed, and Premium plan subscription started. 2. Upgrading from Free to paid plans (Standard or Premium) From Console - Summary, click on 'Subscribe' From the CLO-SET Pricing page, select a plan to subscribe, and follow the payment process. Downgrade (Unsubscribe) Downgrading will take place on your Group's next renewal date. Please note that CLO-SET does not refund the unused days of your monthly subscription once it is initiated. 1. Downgrading from Premium to Standard Important: Once your Group is downgraded to the Standard plan, there will be restrictions on the Group's usage. Please make sure to review the restrictions to minimize disruption. Your existing Premium plan subscription will be valid until the end of your measurement period. On your next renewal date, your plan will be changed to Standard. You CANNOT downgrade if your current usage exceeds the plan limit of the Standard plan. Please review your usage on 'Console - Billing - Usage History' and make changes accordingly. <table style="border-collapse: collapse width: 100%"> 2. Downgrading from Premium/Standard to Free Downgrading will take place on your Group's next renewal date. Please note that CLO-SET does not refund the unused days of your monthly subscription once it is initiated. If you had pending negative credit balance (to be paid) at the point of downgrading, you will be charged for the amount before your subscription is cancelled. If you had pending positive credit balance at the point of downgrading, your credit will be forfeited without cash refunds. You CANNOT downgrade if your current usage exceeds the plan limit of the Free plan. Please review your usage on 'Console - Billing - Usage History' and make changes accordingly. 2) Refund Policy Your subscription is valid until the end of Measurement Period, unless there was an upgrade attempt. Please note that under CLO-SET TOS, no refunds are made for unused number of days in cash form, unless required by law. For any inquiries, please contact us.

Billing History Invoice User History User Type Change Email Change Usage History Details Menu Sub-Menu Details Billing Billing History User History Usage History View invoice details &amp group member history. 1) Billing History Date (UTC/GMT): Date of the event, recorded in UTC, sorted from latest to oldest Invoice No.: Invoice created at each payment cycle. Find more details on Billing Guideline Charges: Amount billed or paid per the event on description Positive values (+): indicate paid amount OR credit that can be used for your next payment Negative values (-): charged to the user to be paid in future Credit balance: Remaining credit balance as a result of each event. Title: CLO-SET Pricing Plan Renewal FAQ
Content: Objective Find the list of frequently asked questions and answers regarding the new CLO-SET Pricing Plan Renewal, upcoming starting November 05, 2024. Plan Types What's changing? When does it start? What do I have to do? Can I continue using Free Plan? Can I pay in Annual Terms? What comes with CLO-SET subscription? Details 1) Plan Types Starting November 5th, CLO-SET will be available in Free, Standard, and Premium Plan. Enterprise plan is also available for larger corporations with advanced security needs. Premium ($40/user): for small &amp medium businesses Standard ($20/user): for small teams Free: for first time users *Enterprise Plan: for large organizations aiming to scale securely and efficiently. 2) What's Changing? More Options: CLO-SET will start providing 2 paid plans, Standard and Premium, tailored for your team size and your 3D journey. Advanced plan is no longer available. Please choose the plan that fits your workflow. Enjoy Advanced Features: CLO-SET Advanced features that were previously unavailable under Free Plan will be open to all plan types, including Tech Pack and High Quality Render. All Members Counted: Under the new pricing plan, all permissions will be a valued 'Paying user', with all the benefits that come with it. Only Group Operator permission will be excluded from the billing. 3) When does it start? Depending on your Group's current subscription/Trial status, the effective date of the new plan may differ. As a default, the new CLO-SET pricing plan begins on November 5th, 2024. 2-month Free Trial If youve applied for the 2-month free trial, you can enjoy any CLO-SET plan free for the first two months. Learn more on how to activate your Trial. You must select one of the new plans to activate the Trial. Your payment will begin once the 2-month Trial period expires. Please find the exact date of your subscription cycle on Console - Summary page. Please note that Trial application closed on November 3, 2024, and no further applications will be accepted. Advanced Plan User If you have been using CLO-SET Advanced Plan, your subscription will remain valid. However, you must select a new plan before your current subscription ends to minimize disruptions. Please find the exact date of your subscription cycle on Console - Summary page. If you have applied for the 2-month Trial in advance: your Trial will begin AFTER your current Advanced Plan expires. This way, you can take the full advantage of your current subscription before you move on to one of the new plans. Please make sure to select a new plan and enter payment information before your current subscription cycle expires. Otherwise, your Group will be downgraded to Free plan after your current measurement period. Find more on how to activate your Trial If you have NOT applied for the 2-month Trial: Please select a new plan and confirm your payment information before your subscription cycle expires. Your new subscription will begin once your Advanced Plan subscription expires. Failure to select a new plan will result in downgrading your Group to Free plan. All Other Groups If you do not belong to the above 2 cases, your Group must select a new plan and subscribe. Failure to subscribe will result in plan restrictions of the new Free Plan and will block actions such as uploading, creating spaces, or inviting users exceeding the limit. Find more on Plan Restrictions. 4) What do I have to do? Visit the new CLO-SET Pricing Page, and select a new plan to subscribe. Click 'Subscribe' and enter your payment information to complete your order. If your Group is applicable to receive the Trial offer or is on an active Advanced Plan subscription, our system will automatically apply it to your bill. 5) Can I continue using Free Plan? We will continue providing a Free Plan options. If you do not wish to subscribe to a paid plan, you may continue using the Free Plan. However, please note that there will be new restrictions on the Free Plan. Please find more on the new CLO-SET Pricing Page. Your Group members will have limited availability to invite new users, create new spaces, and upload files. Please select a paid plan and start your subscription to minimize the distruption. 6) Can I pay in Annual Terms? Yes, of course. Please note that for Annual Invoice payments, you will need to sign a contract with the CLO-SET team. Please contact us for more information. 7) What comes with CLO-SET subscription? By subscribing to a paid plan in CLO-SET, you can invite as many users, create unlimited spaces or contents in CLO-SET. In addition, selective features are available only under paid plans, such as Rendering, APIs, and Embed Viewers. Please note that CLO-SET subscriptions do NOT cover CLO and Marvelous Designer software usage. To start using the software, visit clo3d.com or marvelousdesigner.com. View New Plans

Title: Permission
Content: Objective The following is the permission hierarchy of CLO-SET. Users can be given any one of the following access rights, in descending order of access: Admin &amp Collaborator Editor &amp Viewer Group Operator Updates on Editor/Viewer (Dec 2023) Setup Guide - find PDF guide at the end of the article To view permission by space and functionality, please refer to Permission Table by Space Details 1) Admin &amp Collaborator Permission Admin Collaborator Space Group, Company, Brand Company, Brand Granted by Invited by Admin Access Can create/edit/delete Spaces &amp Styles. Can invite Collaborators and share to Editors/Viewers. Can ONLY create/edit/delete Season(Line) and below. Can share the workroom &amp Company Library to Editors/Viewers. Description Group Admin: All access. Can create/edit/delete all Spaces and invite users to any level of Space. Subject to payment for the entire Group. Company Admin: Can create/edit/delete Company and below. Invite users to the Company. Brand Admin: Can create/edit/delete Brand and below. Invite users to the Brand. Company Collaborator: Can access all features for Company and below. But can ONLY create/edit/delete/share Season (Line) and below. Can share Company Library, Workroom and below. Brand Collaborator: Can access all features for Brand and below. But can ONLY create/edit/delete Season (Line) and below. Can share Company Library, Workroom and below. 2) Editor &amp Viewer Permission Editor Viewer Space Workroom, Assortment, Style (Content) Granted by Shared by Admin/Collaborator/Editor Access Have authority to edit and share Workroom/Assortment/Style that they are shared to. Can only view the Workroom/Assortment/Style that has been shared. Group members can select to grant download/upload options to Viewers when sharing Workroom/Style. Description Enable Download: With the download option, Viewers can download files, tech packs, and rendering images. Enable Upload: With the upload option, Viewers can upload 3D assets and attachments to Workroom/Style. Check out the below article for details on this new feature. https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/5111216531087-New-Feature-CLO-SET-Viewer-Upload-Option- 3) Group Operator Group Operators can only access the Admin Console. In the Admin Console, one can access billing information, user statistics, group settings, and developer page. We recommend assigning your IT or Finance team as Group Operator. Group Operators are non-paying users (Not counted towards group billing). 4) Updates on Editor/Viewer (Dec 2023) Editors and Viewers permission has been updated - you can now delete and move ONLY those you created. See below for further details on the update. Delete Move Copy Editor Only if Content is created by the user. Only if Content is created by the user. Title: Search
Content: Objective Find your Contents with the search feature in CLO-SET. Find it fast. Find it easy. Search Tab Keyword Search Image Search Filters View / Sort Option Workroom/Assortment Search Details 1) Search Tab Access the Search tab from the dashboard. Click the 'Search' icon on the far left. Keyword search Image search Reset search options Filter search results View/Sort option 2) Text Search Search using the Content Name, Creator, or Content ID. Please note that only the Contents to which you have access to will be displayed as the search result. 3) Image Search To start searching with image files, click on 'search by image' icon next to the magnifier icon. Upload an image file, and click 'Apply'. CLO-SET AI will detect the shape, color, and pattern and find similar Contents. Start searching with image files such as: Rendered output of your Content Physical image of the design Pattern images used for the Content 4) Filters Use Search filters to expand or narrow down the search results. Learn what each of the filters indicate: Content Type: Each Content is classified as a single Content Type. You may select the Content Type at the time of upload, or CLO-SET will auto-assign one based on your file format. Space: Select a Company, Brand, or Workroom Space to conduct the search. Click on the icon view lower-level Spaces. Once the selection is made, click 'Next'. User must have 'Viewer' or above permission to select the respective Space. Workflow / Category: Can only be applied once the Space selection is made. 5) View/Sort Option Modify viewing and sorting options: View By: Contents: Search results will show each Content only Colorway: Search results will show each Colorway of the Content Sort By: Last Modified Name: Sorting based on the file name. Workflow: Sorting based on the Workflow steps identified from your Company Settings 6) Workroom/Assortment Search Users can search for a specific Workroom or Assortment by its name. Select the 'Workroom' or 'Assortment' option from the 'Search For' drop down next to the search bar. 1. In Company, Brand, Line, Season From the 'Search For' drop-down menu, select 'Workroom' or 'Assortment' Type in the keyword to search for Workroom/Assortment. Search results display Workroom/Assortment with names that includes your input (Do not support placeholders) When you search for a Workroom/Assortment within a specific Space (Company, Brand, or Line), ALL associated Workrooms/Assortments within that Space will be displayed Hover over the Workroom to view the location path 2. In Season From the 'Search For' drop-down menu, select 'Workroom' or 'Assortment' Type in the keyword to search for Workroom/Assortment. Search results display Workroom/Assortment with names that includes your input (Do not support placeholders) When you search for a Workroom/Assortment within the selected Season Please note that the search results will only display either Workrooms or Assortments per your selection. 3. In Workroom From the 'Search For' drop-down menu, select 'Workroom' Contents of Current Room: search the Contents within the current level Workroom only Contents Including Child Rooms: search the contents from the current Workroom and all its child Workrooms. Workrooms: search the Child Workrooms within the current Workroom Type in the keyword to search for Child Workrooms. Search results display all Child Workrooms with names that includes your input (Do not support placeholders)

Title: Activity Log (Rendering Log)
Content: Permission: Group Admin, Group Operator Objective Access Admin Console by clicking icon on your CLO-SET dashboard. Admin Console shows the Group summary, Billing, Statistics, Activity Log, Settings, and Developer Page. On the Activity Log tab, you may review details on your group's Rendering usage. Rendering Log Details 1) Rendering Log 1. Select the measurement period you want to view. 2. You can search specific members with their registered name or email to view their usage. 3. Click on the field to sort - from highest or from lowest. The field you've chosen will be shown in skyblue. 4. View the Style, Rendering Usage, and Render Setting information for your group.

Title: Copy Space Structure
Content: Permission: may vary per scenario. Please see below. Objective With this feature, you can easily replicate the Space Structure to prepare for a new season. Copy Space Structure Copy Company Copy Brand Copy Line/Season Additional Notes Details 1) Copy Space Structure Simply copy any Space from Company to Season along with sub-level Spaces up to the 1st-depth Workroom. Only the Space Hierarchy will be copied, NOT including the Contents within the original Space. Basics: Go to 'Browse' menu or 'Workspace' to find the Space you want to Copy On the upper-right corner of the Space, click then click 'Copy Space Structure' Insert the name of the new Space, and click 'Confirm' Only the Space Structure will be copied without Contents, Categories, and Workflows 2) Copy Company Structure Permission: Group Admin only Go to Workspace &gt Companies to select the Company to Copy Click on on the upper-right corner of the Company &gt click 'Copy Space Structure' Type in the name of the new Space, and click 'Confirm' Once complete, click on 'Go to the Space'. You will be redirected to the new Company Space. You can also find the new Space on the 'Browse' menu The new Company Space will replicate all Company Settings of the original Company. 3) Copy Brand Structure Permission: Group Admin, Company Admin Option 1: Go to 'Browse' &gt and select the Company within which the Brand is located Option 2: Go to 'Workspace' &gt Brands Click on on the upper-right corner of the Brand &gt click 'Copy Space Structure' Type in the name of the new Brand, and select where you want the new Brand to be You may only choose between Company Spaces you have permission to Once complete, click on 'Go to the Space'. You will be redirected to the new Brand Space. You can also find the new Space on the 'Browse' menu 4) Copy Line/Season Structure Permission: Group Admin, Company Admin, Company Collaborator, Brand Admin Option 1: Go to 'Browse' &gt and select the Brand within which the Line/Season is located Option 2: Go to 'Workspace' &gt Lines/Seasons Click on on the upper-right corner of the Line/Season &gt click 'Copy Space Structure' Type in the name of the new Space, and select where you want the new Line/Season to be You may only choose between Brand Spaces you have permission to Once complete, click on 'Go to the Space'. You will be redirected to the new Space. You can also find the new Space on the 'Browse' menu 5) Additional Notes Please mind that the Copy Space Structure: only copies the Space Hierarchy, NOT the Contents within copying the Space between Groups is unavailable copying Workroom/Assortment level Spaces is unavailable

Title: Linked Contents (Parent-Child Contents)
Content: Permission: ALL (applicable to all Contents you have download/upload access to) Objective With this update, you can now link the Contents when uploading new files from CLO. Create the Parent-Child relationship between old and new seasons OR between block files and final output to better track and manage your assets. How To Requirements Details 1) How To To use this feature, you must first setup CLO-SET Library in CLO 3D. Find instructions HERE. First, download a file from your CLO-SET Library in CLO. When setting up the Link between Contents, this original file will work as the 'Parent Content' Make design edits in CLO3D (ex. create a new Colorway or change fabric/material used) Once the design edit is complete, upload it as a new Content with 'Upload to CLO-SET' option. You can also select Render/Tech Pack via CLO-SET. Please note that 'Linked Contents' feature is not compatible when uploading a new Version. Turn on the 'Linked Content' option to create the Parent-Child relationship. Select the Group to upload the new Content. Please note that Contents in different Groups can not be 'Linked' as a Parent-Child. Turn on 'Linked Content' button. Select the Workroom to upload the new Content. Selecting an existing Content is disabled when the 'Linked Content' option is on. Once uploaded, you can click on 'Linked Contents' to view the Parent/Child Contents. in Content Page From 'Child Content' From 'Parent Content' 2) Requirements 1. Rules for identifying 'Original Content' The 'Original Content' is always the first file you open in CLO3D. If you used multiple files from CLO-SET Library to create the new Content, only the very first file added would be linked as the Original Content. If you started with a non-CLO-SET file and added files from CLO-SET library, the latter would not be linked as the Original Content. 2. Rules for Parent-Child relationship Both of the Parent &amp Child Contents MUST be in the same CLO-SET Group to utilize the 'Linked Content' feature.

Title: Recent vs. Updated Contents
Content: Objective Understand how CLO-SET defines 'Recent' and 'Updated' Contents on the Dashboard. Recent Contents Updated Contents Dashboard / Workspace / Select Modals Details 1) Recent Contents Recent Contents list, or Recently Viewed Contents list, displays the Contents that you have recently viewed or uploaded (including Version uploads) within each Group. 2) Updated Contents Updated Contents displays the Contents with latest updates or those that have been shared to you recently. What's considered an 'update'? Upload (including Versions) Comment &amp replies Move Content Copy Content Workflow change/delete 3) Dashboard/ Workspace / Select Modals List of 'Recent' and 'Upadted' Contents can be found on multiple pages throughout CLO-SET. Dashboard View Workspace Tab Select Modals

Title: Category
Content: Objective Manage the Category of your Content. Customize the field names to match your workflow. What is Category? Category by Content Category Multi-select Category Settings Filter by Category Details 1) What is Category? CLO-SET 'Category' is a customizable field that helps identify the Content, as well as filter the Content for a faster search. Best Practice: We recommend using the Category field for unique terms/labels for your team. ex) 'Basic' line, 'Boyfriend' line, / 'Sunshine Orange', 'Midnight Blue', etc. For generic terms, CLO-SET AI-Search will detect it for you. 2) Category by Content Identify the Category of each Content. Editors or above can make changes. Fields are customizable by Company Admin or above in Company Settings page. 3) Category Multi-select In your Workroom, select the Content(s). From the multi selection bar above, click 'Category' Select the Category to be applied to selected Contents.* Please note that the pre-existing categories of each Content will be overwritten. 4) Category Settings Category fields are customizable in Company Settings page. You may add up to 4 depths of Category. 5) Filter by Category Search faster by filtering the Category. Filters are available on the Search tab OR in Workrooms.
